name: anydo
title: Any.do
description: Manage your Any.do tasks from Raycast: smart quick add (Persian/Jalali and English), reminders, due alerts and reports.
author: arixworks

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.subtitle: Any.do
commands.description: One page to search, add, manage and be reminded of your Any.do tasks

arguments.name: text
arguments.placeholder: Today, Week or Completed — or type a task like “meeting tomorrow 10”

commands.name: due-alerts
commands.title: Due Alerts
commands.subtitle: Background
commands.description: Runs in the background and raises a notification when a task is due

tools.name: search-tasks
tools.title: Search Any.do Tasks
tools.description: Search and filter open Any.do tasks by text, list or due window (today, tomorrow, week, overdue).

tools.name: create-task
tools.title: Create Any.do Task
tools.description: Create a task from free-form text. Understands Jalali/Persian dates and times such as 1405/08/15 19:00, tomorrow at 10, or 25 Aban.

tools.name: complete-task
tools.title: Complete Any.do Task
tools.description: Mark an Any.do task as done, matched by title or id.

tools.name: set-reminder
tools.title: Set Any.do Reminder
tools.description: Set or change the due date and reminder of a task using free-form text, including Jalali dates and repeats.

tools.name: tasks-today
tools.title: Today on Any.do
tools.description: List today's and overdue Any.do tasks with counts.
